info.title: Shijie Learning Platform API
info.description: 课堂 → 练习 → 巩固 智能学习闭环平台后端。Contract-first; /openapi.json 是唯一机器契约。

delete.description: Soft delete; hard deletion of audio/transcript/RAG chunks is the worker's job.

patch.description: Edit one segment with optimistic concurrency (version). 409 on stale version.

get.description: Paginated personal question view: my questions + my relations to bank questions.

post.description: Manual/text import with confirmation (OCR flow calls this after user correction).
Upload -> OCR draft -> preview. Nothing is saved as a Question until user confirms.
Favorite -> UserQuestion row -> visible in Module 2 immediately. Idempotent.

get.description: User's knowledge points with mastery estimates (weak ones first).

post.description: Complete review with an attempt -> ReviewLog + MemoryState update + next task.
Skip != correct. Memory state untouched; planner reschedules later today/tomorrow.
'已掌握' suspends the question (lower frequency), never deletes — restorable.

get.description: SSE progress stream — frontend renders stage copy, never polls blindly.

post.description:
Issue a short-lived one-time ticket for the WS handshake (browser cannot set
Authorization header on WebSocket). lesson_id must belong to the user.
